glsa.title: OpenRGB: Multiple Vulnerabilities
glsa.synopsis: Multiple vulnerabilities have been found in OpenRGB, allowing root remote command execution.

background.p: OpenRGB is a cross-platform software suite for controlling RGB LED lighting devices.

description.p: Multiple vulnerabilities have been discovered in OpenRGB. Please review the CVE identifiers referenced below for details.

impact.p: Please review the referenced CVE identifiers for details.

workaround.p: There is no known workaround at this time. Users are recommended to avoid exposing OpenRGB to the network even with these fixes.

resolution.p: All OpenRGB users should upgrade to the latest version:
